scope: AMCF-lite real UNSW-NB15 technical robustness; NOT original R20 experiments
statistical_method: Wilson 95% CI for held-out test flow recall/FPR; paired class-stratified multinomial nonparametric bootstrap for AMCF-lite minus baseline differences. All seeds reuse the same fixed public test partition; seed repetitions are not independent new holdout datasets.
caveat: Validation FPR targets do not imply held-out test FPR control; never choose a threshold using the test labels. No temporal/incident, drift, safety, human-factors, or full AMCF evaluation.
